entries.title: Best Youth Softball Gloves: Sized Right for 8-12U
entries.reason: Partial-article gap, not skipped entirely (article carries 2 links as of 2026-08-09: softball-glove-11in and baseball-glove-breakin-kit). Two other product mentions checked and left unlinked. (1) 'Best budget pick (rec play, 8U-10U): Entry-level synthetic glove from Wilson or Rawlings, $40-80 range' names two brands with no single model; searched Amazon for a Wilson youth synthetic softball glove in that price/age band and found only adult slowpitch (A360, $43.73) or a competitive 11.75-12.5in fastpitch model (A500 Siren, $67.40) that doesn't match the 10U-age sizing the text implies, so no confident single-product match. (2) 'Best for travel/competitive 12U+: Louisville Slugger LXT series' could not be sourced: Louisville Slugger's LXT line is a fastpitch bat, not a glove (confirmed via Amazon search, top result 'Louisville Slugger 2025 LXT' bat, $353.83); no Louisville Slugger glove called LXT exists to link, and the article's own product name appears to be in error. Not linking a bat under a sentence about gloves, and not guessing a substitute glove the article didn't name.
